goodFor: Concise articles on algorithms and data structures, each with an implementation, for reference beside an algorithms course.

notes: Link only. The project's GitHub repository, which builds the site, states CC BY-SA 4.0: the footer text in mkdocs.yml says the text is CC BY-SA 4.0 and the LICENSE file is that licence. But the README says the project translates e-maxx.ru/algo into English, and many articles are such translations or extend them; e-maxx's own licence, and any permission to relicense its articles, weren't found, so whether the CC BY-SA grant covers the translated text is unknown and the translated articles can't be cleanly separated from the original ones. The site cp-algorithms.com isn't reachable from here, so its rendered footer, any terms page and any per-article notices weren't read. The articles' code samples have no separate licence stated. Many topics are contest techniques beyond lower-division; the basic ones (binary search, graph search, shortest paths, introductory dynamic programming) suit an algorithms course. Move to entries only after the site's pages and e-maxx's terms are read. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
